# Starter Kit catalog

The plugins and themes of the Starter Kit, their newest releases and what each needs, for a project to compare with what it has installed. A project reads `v1/catalog.json` with a plain GET and compares on its own server; nothing is sent here.

`schema` is the version of the format. Fields may be added within a schema; a change an older reader would misread gets a new schema in a new directory, published beside this one.
